Solid: current ROI · Dashed: suggested maximum. Tap to move.

Deselect calibration frames before changing the capture range.

The estimate includes accumulation, registration, snapshots, demosaicing and calibration. Software Bin runs after sensor calibration and demosaicing, so those buffers stay at input resolution. The budget is capped at 40% of the app heap and 256 MiB. Processing also retains a 16.78 MP image ceiling and a 32 MiB live input-frame limit. These are estimates, not measured peak memory. ROI alignment follows the camera controls.
